meta.name: kanmashi
meta.description: The show follows Rohini, a young woman who faces social prejudice and discrimination over her complexion. The title Kanmashi (the Malayalam word for kajal or eyeline) acts as a metaphor for inner character and emotions that go beyond physical appearances. The narrative combines family drama and romance with unexpected mystery and supernatural elements.
